name: modelwise
description: For any department and industry: decide like the top practitioner, then pick the right Anthropic/OpenAI model and effort for each phase and write model-specific prompts, with cost comparisons.

interface.longDescription: Type a basic prompt and get the best Anthropic or OpenAI model for it, the reasoning effort to use, a cost comparison across all current models, a structured prompt in the format that model prefers, and token-saving tips. All model facts come from a curated registry built from official vendor docs; runs fully locally.
defaultPrompt: Use modelwise: landing page for my bakery
Use modelwise to find the cheapest way to classify 50,000 support tickets
Use modelwise: which model and effort for debugging a failing Next.js build?
